note: Shannon County renamed Oglala Lakota County effective May 2015; FIPS changed from 46113 to 46102 (the number went DOWN, not up -- verified directly, do not assume the naive direction).
Wade Hampton Census Area renamed Kusilvak Census Area effective July 2015 (FIPS 02270 -> 02158, same boundary).

Prince of Wales-Outer Ketchikan Census Area (retired May 2008) renamed/reduced to Prince of Wales-Hyder Census Area (02198) after small slivers were annexed into the already-existing Ketchikan Gateway Borough (02130) and Wrangell City and Borough (02275). Those slivers are not allocated here -- unlike the splits in historical_splits.csv, 02130/02275 already existed before this change, so their current land area is not a valid proxy for the annexed sliver's share. Treated as a 1:1 approximation; the annexed areas are understood to be sparsely populated but this is not independently verified.

Dade County renamed Miami-Dade County effective July 1997; FIPS changed from 12025 to 12086 (same boundary, no split). Found via rpa-landuse-2030's live georef.csv, not anticipated from the downscaling repo alone -- confirms this package needs re-validating against each new consumer's real data, not just the first one.
